[roster setup=C task=T59]

HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.
- Tests: `bun test <your test path>` must pass and `bun test` (whole suite) must not regress. Never modify existing tests
  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.

TASK T59 · W2 · `roster review` runs difficulty and the suspect test
GOAL: Every review says "insufficient data", because src/cli/review.ts hard-codes label "insufficient_data" and suspect null with the
note "the difficulty-matched Mantel–Haenszel test is not part of this command yet". src/difficulty (difficulty, terciles,
reviewDifficulty) and src/review/suspect.ts (suspect) are built and tested but never called. Wire them in.
READ: src/cli/review.ts (the Review object near `label: "insufficient_data"` and the TIMED stages), src/difficulty/index.ts
(reviewDifficulty, difficulty, terciles), src/review/suspect.ts (suspect, labels, MIN_MATURE_SESSIONS), src/types.ts (Outcome.difficulty,
Outcome.tercile, Review), docs/DESIGN.md §"Difficulty and review".
OWNS: src/cli/review.ts, tests/review-suspect.test.ts, and any assertion in tests/cli-review.test.ts, tests/review-contract.test.ts or
tests/review-unattended-labels.test.ts that encodes the hard-coded label or the "not part of this command" note (you may modify those;
say which)
BUILD: After scoring, run the difficulty stage (timed as "difficulty"), set each outcome's difficulty and tercile, then call suspect()
on mature outcomes with setup ids, and put its label (mapped to the Review label enum), suspect setup id, odds ratio, CI and p into
review.json. Remove the "not part of this command" note; keep notes that explain the result in plain words (for example "no setup
has ≥ 8 mature sessions" for insufficient data). Difficulty failures fall back as src/difficulty documents and never fail the review.
ACCEPTANCE: tests on fixtures: the confound scenario gives "no suspect" (or insufficient) rather than flagging X; a true-effect fixture
gives a suspect with p < 0.05 in review.json; difficulty appears in the timing line. Whole suite green, typecheck clean.
TEST: bun test tests/review-suspect.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.
